Description for the new library item. If not set, the new library item inherits the description of the source virtual machine. This property was added in vSphere API 6.8.

Per-disk storage specifications for the virtual machine template. Specified as a mapping of source virtual machine disk identifiers (MOIDs of com.vmware.vcenter.vm.hardware.Disk resources) to their storage…

Identifier of the content library in which the new library item should be created. Must be an identifier (MOID) for a com.vmware.content.Library resource. Required when state. This property was added in vSphere API 6.8.
When state, the name of the new library item to create. When state, the name of the new virtual machine to deploy. Required for both present and deploy. This property was added in vSphere API 6.8.
Whether the deployed virtual machine should be powered on after deployment. Applies when state. If not set, the virtual machine is left powered off. This property was added in vSphere API 6.8.
Timeout in seconds for the whole operation including connection establishment, request sending, and response.
Identifier of the source virtual machine to create the library item from. Must be an identifier (MOID) for a VirtualMachine resource. Required when state. This property was added in vSphere API 6.8.

The desired state of the resource. Use present to create a virtual machine template library item from a source virtual machine. Use deploy to deploy a new virtual machine from a template library item.
Identifier of the template library item to deploy from. Must be an identifier (MOID) for a TemplateLibraryItem resource. Required when state.

Identifier of the datastore for the template's disks. Must be an identifier (MOID) for a Datastore resource. This suboption is currently required.
Policy type to apply to the template's disks. USE_SPECIFIED_POLICY - Use the storage policy given in policy. This property was added in vSphere API 6.8.

Identifier of the storage policy to use. Must be an identifier (MOID) for a com.vmware.spbm.StorageProfile resource. Only relevant when type is USE_SPECIFIED_POLICY. This property was added in vSphere API 6.8.
Name of an existing guest customization specification to apply. If not set, no guest customization is performed. This property was added in vSphere API 6.8.
Identifiers of disks to remove from the deployed virtual machine. Each entry must be an identifier (MOID) for a com.vmware.vcenter.vm.hardware.Disk resource.
Per-disk update specifications for the deployed virtual machine, keyed by disk identifier (MOID of a com.vmware.vcenter.vm.hardware.Disk resource).

Mapping of Ethernet adapters to update, keyed by adapter identifier (MOID of a com.vmware.vcenter.vm.hardware.Ethernet resource). If not set, all adapters stay connected to the same networks as in the template.
Number of cores per socket for the deployed virtual machine. If not set, the deployed virtual machine keeps the template's cores-per-socket value. This property was added in vSphere API 6.8.
Number of virtual processors for the deployed virtual machine. If not set, the deployed virtual machine keeps the template's CPU count. This property was added in vSphere API 6.8.
Memory size for the deployed virtual machine, in MB. If not set, the deployed virtual machine keeps the template's memory size. This property was added in vSphere API 6.8.
Identifier of the cluster to place the template on. Must be an identifier (MOID) for a ClusterComputeResource resource. If resource_pool is also set, it must belong to this cluster.

Identifier of the virtual machine folder to place the template in. Must be an identifier (MOID) for a Folder resource. If not set, the template is placed in the same folder as the source virtual machine.
Identifier of the host to place the template on. Must be an identifier (MOID) for a HostSystem resource. If resource_pool is also set, it must belong to this host.
Identifier of the resource pool to place the template in. Must be an identifier (MOID) for a ResourcePool resource.

The name of the vSphere category that the tag belongs to. This property was added in vSphere API 9.1.0.0.
The name of the tag to attach. This property was added in vSphere API 9.1.0.0.

Identifier of the storage policy to use. Must be an identifier (MOID) for a com.vmware.spbm.StorageProfile resource. Only relevant when type is USE_SPECIFIED_POLICY. This property was added in vSphere API 6.8.
